title: countersignatures ignore AutoFirma's `target`
notes: and countersign every top-level signer (nested ones are not
countersigned); detached and internally detached XAdES cannot be cosigned.
Next: when a sede sends one.
result: AutoScript routes CAdES and XAdES countersignatures to the original whole tree or original leaves and rejects unsupported or archived targets.
evidence: pnpm exec vitest run src/signing/cms src/signing/xades src/signing/autoscript: 220 passed. Local CMS verification and xmlsec1 validated the old and new signatures; mixed subtrees, signed payload isolation and refusal of archive timestamps were covered.
